q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of fish meal per tonne?
title: Fish meal carbon footprint per tonne
short: Fish meal plants cook, press and dry the catch, so steam and dryer fuel dominate plant energy. Divide the boiler fuel and electricity by tonnes of meal dispatched, and list fish oil as a co-product with a stated allocation.
audience: Fish meal and fish oil plants on the west and east coasts

ul: Whole fish or fish processing waste by weight.
Diesel used by the boats, if you report the catch.
Pressing, then drying in steam or direct fired dryers.

p: Report per tonne of meal and state how you split energy between meal and oil, by mass or by value.

example.title: Worked example: fish meal unit per tonne (one month)
lines: Plant total: 768,600 / 1,000 = 768.6 kg CO2 per tonne
Add catch and bags for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
